## Verdict: PASS

I independently reviewed the frozen DG0 candidate `sha256:9420948b55a5131e…` (source commit `49b5ad7`). Candidate confirmed via `candidate.mjs` (working-tree and `--ref` both match), complete non-shallow clone. I authored none of the reviewed scope and formed my verdict before reading any other round-27 record.

**The D-043 delta is comment-only, as claimed.** `git diff 7edacdc..49b5ad7 -- rules.mjs` changes only the `commitPresent()` header comment: 0 non-comment lines changed, and rules.mjs with all `//` comments stripped is byte-identical (`352604df…`) at both commits; `node --check` passes. The closure model is now documented in exactly one place (`checkClosure`), matching the code (anchor 1 unconditional); the `commitPresent()` header states no policy; no comment contradicts the code.

**Checks run (all PASS):**
- node **102/102**, python **22/22**, source extraction, `prefreeze.sh DG0` — all pass in fresh `--no-local` clones.
- Standing closure controls (SEC24–27) reproduce with an **identical pass/fail set** on `49b5ad7` and `7edacdc` — absent-source-round rejection (F-DG0-169), post-freeze/anchor-1 (F-DG0-168), forged-absent/anchor-2 (F-DG0-166/249), absent/all-zero `fix_revision`+`head_commit_at_start`, immutable-field lock (F-DG0-165), shallow refusal (F-DG0-160), anchor independence.
- Real-repo census: 116 closures, 0 anchor failures/skips.
- Write confinement: 18/18 protected/other-role writes refused; residual 7 (`/proc/sys` incl. `core_pattern`) confirmed **exactly as disclosed** (F-DG0-149, already ACCEPTED_OBSERVATION), not larger.
- No secrets/CDNs; CI `contents: read` + SHA-pinned actions; `.claude` auto-allows only `Bash(bwrap:*)`; candidate hash deterministic.
- All **19** DG0-final requirements IMPLEMENTED with existing evidence; assigned set equals the register.

**Findings:**
- **F-DG0-170** (Low, non-mandatory, documentation-only) — my own round-26 finding — reproduced at `7edacdc`, shown fixed at `49b5ad7`; fix `db5afe8` satisfies all three closure anchors. Closed **CLOSED_VERIFIED** in my verifications sidecar.
- **No new** Critical/High/Medium/Low findings. **No unresolved mandatory violations.**

Records written: `docs/delivery/reviews/DG0/round-27/code-security-reviewer.{json,verifications.json,md}` (record validates against the schema; all evidence paths exist). This is an engineering review only — it grants no business, Finance or IT approval.
